name: The Wheel of Time
author: Robert Jordan
description: The Wheel of Time is an epic fantasy series that follows Rand al'Thor's journey from a simple shepherd to the Dragon Reborn. With 14 books averaging 30-40 hours each, this is the longest completed fantasy series and phenomenal credit value.

name: The Stormlight Archive
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: Brandon Sanderson's epic fantasy series set on the storm-ravaged world of Roshar. Each book exceeds 45 hours with outstanding narration by Kate Reading and Michael Kramer.

name: Mistborn
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: Brandon Sanderson's innovative fantasy series featuring allomancy, a unique magic system where select people can burn metals for supernatural abilities.

name: The Expanse
author: James S.A. Corey
description: A critically acclaimed science fiction series spanning humanity's colonization of the solar system and beyond. Jefferson Mays' narration is widely considered among the best in audiobook history.

name: A Song of Ice and Fire
author: George R.R. Martin
description: The epic fantasy series that inspired Game of Thrones. Political intrigue, dragons, and unforgettable characters in the war-torn land of Westeros.

name: Dune Chronicles
author: Frank Herbert
description: Frank Herbert's landmark science fiction series set in the distant future amidst a feudal interstellar society, centered on the desert planet Arrakis and the spice melange.

name: Harry Potter
author: J.K. Rowling
description: The world's most beloved fantasy series follows a young wizard's journey through Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Stephen Fry's narration is legendary.
books: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

name: Farseer Trilogy
author: Robin Hobb
description: Robin Hobb's beloved epic fantasy following FitzChivalry Farseer, a royal bastard trained as an assassin in a world of political intrigue and ancient magic.

name: Murderbot Diaries
author: Martha Wells
description: A Hugo and Nebula award-winning series about a security android that hacks its own governor module and just wants to be left alone to watch soap operas.

name: The Kingkiller Chronicle
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: Patrick Rothfuss's beautifully written fantasy series following the legendary Kvothe, from his childhood in a troupe of traveling players to his years at a university of magic.

name: The Lord of the Rings
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: J.R.R. Tolkien's masterwork and the foundation of modern fantasy. An epic journey across Middle-earth to destroy the One Ring.
